_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: Closing search with Escape resets the query and all search filters. The browser's requests carry the header X-ExeDev-Email: me@example.com, so the current user is me@example.com. The test harness has already stubbed the server's conversation list and cut off its live update stream, so there is nothing to set up, intercept or check about that (do not look at the API): the drawer (".drawer") shows the conversations the test names, as rows [data-conversation-id="<id>"] whose title (".conversation-title") is their slug, which is their id (drafts have none), and whose preview is "Preview". The list is "mine" (written in by me@example.com, tagged alpha, unread) and "other" (written in by other@example.com). "The search toggle" is the button "Search conversations...". The search query editor is the contenteditable element with data-testid "conversation-query-editor" ("the editor"); its data-query-value attribute is the serialized query. "The query is X" means data-query-value is exactly X, spaces included. To "set the query to X": eval the editor's focus(), press_key "a" with modifiers "Control" (the editor's own select-all), insert_text X (as pasting would), then wait until the query is X. To "clear the query": eval the editor's focus(), press_key "a" with modifiers "Control", press Backspace, then wait until the query is "". Query tokens are [data-conversation-query-token="<kind>"] elements inside the editor (kind tag or user); "the token T" is the one whose text contains T. Perform the numbered steps in order, each fully. A button "X" is {"role": "button", "name": "X", "exact": true}, with a "selector" to scope it when it is a row's, a menu's or a group's; but "there is no button X" counts {"role": "button", "name": "X"} without exact, so that a name containing X counts too. Texts that "are exactly [...]" are checked with assert_texts. "There is no S", "no S" or "none" means no element matches at all: assert_count 0, never a visibility check. Whether an element "has the class X" is an eval of its classList.contains('X') (polled with expect), never a visibility check: a collapsed drawer may have no size. Every selector you need is given here, so do not explore the source code or read other tests (the old Playwright spec is being replaced and does not apply): write all the steps in one run_steps call right away, and look something up only if a step fails. 1. Navigate to /new. 2. Click the search toggle. 3. Click the button "Activity". 4. Click the button "1d+" inside ".drawer-bulk-popover". 5. [data-conversation-query-token="activity"] should be visible. 6. Set the query to "user:me@example.com tag:alpha is:unread ". 7. [data-conversation-id="other"] is not visible. 8. Close search: focus the editor (eval its focus()) and press Escape. 9. There should be no editor; the search toggle does not have the class "search-toggle-active"; [data-conversation-id="mine"] and [data-conversation-id="other"] are visible. 10. Click the search toggle. 11. The query is "". 12. There is no [data-conversation-query-token="activity"]. 13. Data-testid "unread-toggle" has aria-pressed "false".
